content_story_city_bark_3_0: I fell on purpose. And it worked!
content_story_city_bark_4_0: Wait! Pop a lamp first. Drop on it, hard.
content_story_city_bark_5_0: Falling is not losing. Down is just the way to the next up.
content_story_cut_lowtown_0_0: This is Lowtown. It sits at the bottom of a very tall tower.
content_story_cut_lowtown_0_1: One morning, the ground got warm.
content_story_cut_lowtown_1_0: Wake up! The lava is coming up!
content_story_cut_lowtown_1_1: Everybody climbs today. All the way to Floor Fifty.
content_story_cut_lowtown_2_0: Look! That's Oni. The best climber there is.
content_story_cut_lowtown_2_1: Rule one, little climber. Don't look down.
content_story_cut_lowtown_2_2: Rule two. Don't wait for anybody.
content_story_cut_lowtown_2_3: I'm going to be first. Just like Oni.
content_story_cut_lowtown_2_4: First? I'll just be happy to get there!
content_story_cut_the_city_0_0: Above Lowtown is the city. Nobody is home.
content_story_cut_the_city_0_1: Look. Glims, stuck in the old lamps!
content_story_cut_the_city_1_0: Leave them. They will slow you down.
content_story_cut_the_city_1_2: Then we look. Drop on a lamp, hard. It pops right open!
content_story_cut_the_deep_0_0: Higher still, the tower is full of water. The floors drift about.
content_story_cut_the_deep_0_1: I can see Oni! We are catching up!
content_story_cut_the_deep_0_2: You go fast. I'll keep up. I always do.
content_story_cut_the_ledge_0_0: Almost at Floor Fifty. Then you hear a shout. From below.
content_story_cut_the_ledge_0_1: My ledge broke. I never saw it. I never look down.
content_story_cut_the_ledge_1_0: Go on. Be first. That is the rule.
content_story_cut_the_top_0_0: Floor Fifty. The top of the tower. The lava cannot reach.
content_story_cut_the_top_0_1: We made it! Who was first?
content_story_cut_the_top_0_2: I don't know. I was not looking up.
content_story_cut_the_top_1_0: You let the glims go. One by one, they lit up the morning.
content_story_cut_the_top_1_1: I never looked down. I never knew it looked like this.
content_story_cut_the_top_2_0: More climbers were still coming. Oni was the first to reach down.
content_story_cut_the_top_2_1: Rule one, little climber. Look down.
content_story_cut_together_0_0: You were nearly first. Now you are near the bottom.
content_story_cut_together_0_1: You gave up first place. For me?
content_story_cut_together_0_2: Oni is wrong. I looked down, and I saw you.
content_story_cut_together_1_0: The lava is right behind us. Ready?
content_story_deep_bark_0_0: These floors swim. Wait for one, then hop.
content_story_deep_bark_2_0: I'm right behind Oni! I'm nearly first!
content_story_deep_bark_3_0: Aaah! I'm okay! But my leg is stuck!
content_story_deep_bark_4_0: Hold on, Frog! I'm coming down!
content_story_deep_bark_7_0: The lava got you. So what? Up again.
content_story_fifty_bark_0_0: Hold on, Oni! I'm coming down!
content_story_fifty_bark_2_0: Everybody up! The lava is coming!
content_story_fifty_bark_3_0: I can see it. Floor Fifty!
content_story_fifty_bark_4_0: The lava got you. So what? Up again.
